Name: Minecart Issues
Author: Typhe681
Description:
Ever thought that minecarts are a bit overpowered? This mod adds a random chance every day for minecarts to break down.

[b][size=5]Features[/size]
[/b]• At the start of every day there is a chance for the minecart system to break down
• Upon first clicking the one of broken-down minecarts, a letter will appear explaining why it broke
• The minecart system will be automatically repaired after a certain amount of days (default is 3)
• You can pay to repair the minecart system faster[b]

[size=5]Config[/size]
[/b]• DailyBreakChance is the percent chance per day for the minecarts to break down (default is 1%, so 112% chance per year)
• RepairTimeDays is the amount of days until the minecart system is repaired without player input (default is 3)
• QuickRepairCost is the amount of gold needed to repair the minecart system manually (repairs overnight, default is 5000)

[b][size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[/b]• This mod is NOT multiplayer compatible 
• With certain minecart mods, custom minecarts can still be accessed due to the way the cart is set up (ex: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts's[/url] Farm Cart)

[b][size=5]Installation[/size]
[/b]• [size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
• Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[size=2]• Download this mod and place the unzipped folder into [code]StardewValley/Mods[/code][/size]• Run the game through SMAPI
